summary: Ubisoft Paris' Wii-exclusive first-person shooter and stand-alone sequel.

entries.title: Red Steel

emulation.notes: Original Wii hardware is the reference route; Dolphin can upscale but motion-control mapping needs care.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Dolphin upscaling with Wii motion-control caveats

primary.why: Red Steel was released exclusively for Wii as a 2006 launch-period motion-control shooter. Wii is the only sourced release and therefore the primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii hardware with Wii Remote and Nunchuk, or use Dolphin only if you can reproduce the required motion controls cleanly.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC port or modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.
